walkthroughs.body_html: if score >= 50: runs one block; else: runs another. Indentation tells Python which lines belong inside the branch.
== equal, != not equal, >, <, >=, <=. The result is a boolean.
Use elif to test more conditions. Python checks each from top to bottom and runs only the first that is true.
